components.name: Rail button with title
components.description: Persistent destination with hover and keyboard-focus title.
components.css: .ds-rail-button{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:40px;height:40px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#a4a4a4);cursor:pointer;transition:color 140ms ease,background 140ms ease;}.ds-rail-button:hover,.ds-rail-button[aria-current="page"]{background:#363636;color:#fff;}.ds-rail-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--muted,#a4a4a4);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-rail-tooltip{position:absolute;left:calc(100% + 12px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(-3px);padding:7px 10px;border-radius:6px;background:#eee;color:var(--shell,#181818);font:500 12px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 12px #0003;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 120ms ease,transform 120ms ease,visibility 120ms;}.ds-rail-button:hover .ds-rail-tooltip,.ds-rail-button:focus-visible .ds-rail-tooltip{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateY(-50%);transition-delay:180ms;}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-rail-tooltip{display:none;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-rail-button,.ds-rail-tooltip{transition:none!important;animation:none!important;}}

components.name: Navigation row
components.description: Left-panel destination with a distinct current state.
components.css: .ds-nav-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:36px;width:100%;padding:7px 10px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:#d1d1d1;font:400 13px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background 140ms ease,color 140ms ease;}.ds-nav-row svg{flex:0 0 18px;color:#b1b1b1;}.ds-nav-row span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}.ds-nav-row:hover{color:#fff;background:#2f2f2f;}.ds-nav-row[aria-current="page"]{color:#fff;background:#353535;}.ds-nav-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--muted,#a4a4a4);outline-offset:3px;}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-nav-row{min-height:42px;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav-row{transition:none!important;animation:none!important;}}

components.name: Workspace search
components.description: A secondary search icon beside Dashboard opens a field in place of that navigation header; Cmd/Ctrl+K also opens it.
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-width:0;padding-left:0;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:8px;color:var(--muted,#a4a4a4);background:#303030;}.ds-search>svg{flex-shrink:0;}.ds-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;height:36px;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text,#ededed);font:400 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;caret-color:var(--text,#ededed);}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#a4a4a4);}.ds-search:focus-within{outline:2px solid #888;outline-offset:1px;}.ds-search button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;width:28px;height:34px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#a4a4a4);cursor:pointer;transition:background 140ms ease,color 140ms ease;}.ds-search button:hover{background:#ffffff0d;color:#fff;}.ds-search button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--muted,#a4a4a4);outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-search{transition:none!important;animation:none!important;}}

narrative.overview:
The user's ChatGPT desktop reference fixes the shell's visual direction: charcoal navigation, a near-black workspace, system typography, and restrained outline icons. Compact controls and tonal selection states keep the investing content prominent.

This record extracts the implemented system from `frontend/src/index.css`, `frontend/tailwind.config.ts`, and `frontend/src/components/shell/`. Existing financial colors retain their meaning. The left navigation behavior is defined in `.impeccable/shell-brief.md`; the right order-entry panel retains its existing interactions.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent icon navigation with hover and keyboard-focus titles.
Compact rows, quiet separators, and rounded control states.
Flat workspace surfaces with independent scrolling.
Financial status colors distinct from neutral navigation states.
dos: Do preserve the supplied ChatGPT desktop reference when extending the shell.
Do keep the icon rail visible when the left navigation panel collapses.
Do preserve financial color meanings, accessible labels, and visible keyboard focus.
Do use the existing system type, compact spacing, and neutral state fills for shared navigation.
Keep Crypto within the expandable navigation, without a separate rail button.
Use a straight sidebar-to-content boundary and let existing workspace tabs occupy the top space; omit the separate history toolbar.
Use an integrated macOS title bar with real traffic lights and an adjacent sidebar toggle. Hide repeated branding; place search as a secondary icon beside Dashboard.
Use shared neutral surface, text, and control-state tokens for menus and chart tooltips. Period menu options use normal title-case text; reserve financial colors for their existing semantic roles.
Keep navigation focused on accounts and grouped tools without Recents. Represent Crypto with a Bitcoin-marked front coin and two coin outlines stacked behind it.
donts: Don't extend left-panel interaction changes to the right order-entry panel.
Don't use financial status colors as decorative navigation accents.
Don't flatten attached workspace tabs into pills or separate the active tab from its panel.
Don't rely on hover titles as the only accessible names for icon controls.
